title: GeneratedArtifactRegistry
description: AC-0.15/P0.9 seed registry for generated artifacts plus merge-conflict readiness. This local/static contract records generator/source/output ownership and fail-closed merge-tree/path-overlap fixtures without claiming full-repo generated-artifact coverage, Phase-1 Tide batching, live required-context authority, P0.0 green, Phase-0 completion, production readiness, or hyperscaler-grade readiness.

_meta.source_request: Phase 0 must publish conflict taxonomy, generated-artifact registry, merge-tree readiness fixtures, and one-lane-one-path/path-overlap claims without claiming Phase-1 Tide batching.

official_references.name: Git documentation: git merge-tree
official_references.used_for: Local tree-merge simulation engine selection for readiness fixtures.

coverage_scope.included_scope: Checked-in generated artifacts required for AC-0.15 merge-conflict foundation and P0.9 seed registry evidence.
coverage_scope.excluded_scope: This seed registry does not claim full-repo generated-artifact discovery, drift-free regeneration, or live controller enforcement until a trusted cloud-ci/oya-ci lane runs the expanded P0.9 drift gate.

artifact_entry_contract.source_rule: Every registered output must name checked-in sources that govern regeneration.
artifact_entry_contract.owner_rule: Every registered output must name a team owner and a single-lane path-ownership rule.
artifact_entry_contract.non_claim_rule: Registry publication is local/static evidence only unless trusted cloud-ci/oya-ci posts the required context from controller/trunk-owned definitions.

registered_artifacts.commit_policy: Source inputs and generated output must land together in one lane; hand edits outside the captured patch are stale-output blockers.
registered_artifacts.stale_output_policy: RED if third-party/BUCK changes without a registered source input, regeneration command, owner, and generated marker.

registered_artifacts.commit_policy: Lane-owned shard edits and generated aggregate updates must land together; hand edits to the generated YAML are stale-output blockers.
registered_artifacts.stale_output_policy: RED if the generated YAML diverges from registry/shard rendering or loses the generated marker.

registered_artifacts.commit_policy: Lane-owned shard edits and generated controller config updates must land together; hand edits to the generated YAML are stale-output blockers.
registered_artifacts.stale_output_policy: RED if the generated controller config diverges from registry/shard rendering or loses the generated marker.

conflict_taxonomy.description: git merge-tree --write-tree reports a clean tree; still local/static readiness only.
git merge-tree --write-tree reports a textual/tree conflict before provider-side merge.
Two active lanes claim the same path without explicit overlap review and owner acknowledgement.
A generated output changed without a matching generated-artifact registry entry and regeneration source path.
A generated output lacks the generated marker, regeneration command, source pairing, or drift gate required by the registry.
A lane claims paths outside its single-writer scope or lacks an owner for overlap escalation.
Local fixtures mention Phase-1 projected-state batching as proven before live cloud-ci/oya-ci Tide evidence exists.

lane_ownership_policy.claim_boundary: One-lane-one-path and merge-tree fixture checks are local/static readiness evidence, not Phase-1 Tide batching or live merge authority.

automated_chain: git merge-tree --write-tree local readiness simulation only
cloud-ci/oya-ci oya-ci-required required context after live producer cutover
